offers_products.reason: Offers diagnostic imaging services and reports; no goods or software sold as main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Outpatient diagnostic imaging centers and Connexia subspecialized radiology reads are clinical services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients receive outpatient imaging at its centers and are the end recipients of care.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Health system joint ventures, hospital partners and referring providers buy radiology reads and imaging partnerships.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from per-scan patient visits and reads, which are episodic rather than contracted or subscription-based.

cyclical_demand.reason: Diagnostic imaging is physician-ordered medical care, so patients rarely postpone it in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Individual diagnostic scans are routine, relatively small, frequent procedures billed mostly through insurance.

people_delivered.reason: Imaging centers depend on expensive scanners and facilities as well as radiologists; asset-based care delivery, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main payers and buyers are patients, referring physicians and hospital partners; insurers pay, not large enterprise buyers.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates outpatient imaging centers with costly MRI/CT equipment and joint-venture facilities needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Recognition based only on website text; payer mix and revenue split between imaging centers and radiology reads are not stated.
